Welcome Home to The Summit of Jenks 918-299-8600
411 West K Place Jenks, OK 74037 (NE Corner of 91st ("K") & Elm/Peoria)

We are conveniently located in the Heart of Jenks where shopping and entertainment is right around the corner. You will love how peaceful our community is and how friendly the residents are!

Application Fee $40.00 (Per person over 18 years of age)


**Only responsible for electric and renter's insurance**

Apartment Amenities:
• Total Electric Unit (No Gas Bill!)
• Spacious Closets
• Stainless Steel Sinks
• Garbage Disposal
• Full Size Washer/Dryer Connections

Complex Info:
• New Exterior Paint & Siding
• Interior Paint Earth Tones
• Sparkling Salt Water Swimming Pool
• Large Playground
• School Bus Stop on Property
• 24/7 Laundry Facility
• 24-HOUR Emergency Maintenance
• Manicured Grounds
• Peaceful Community

1/2 Mile from Riverwalk Crossing
Less than 3 miles from Tulsa Hills Shopping
1/2 North from Main Street Jenks
1/2 Mile from Jenks High School

Business Hours:
Monday - Friday 9:30AM - 5:30PM

We do not accept Section 8 (Housing Vouchers)
We do not accept felons.
